comparison: episode actual J=(-F,N,-E,-C,-exposure,-normal_delay_sum,-energy); counts exact; exposure/delay round8; energy round10
denominators: counts/proportions all requests; conditional normal delay sum divided by all normally landed requests, never unweighted episode means
timing_scope: raw per-decision times pooled by method/profile; p95 linear interpolation at0.95*(n-1); generation includes feasibility; cold load and environment stepping separate; concurrent local wall-clock measurements are not real-time guarantees
reference_scope: full_reference is bounded exact evaluation of its generated candidate pool, not a global oracle; rolling_horizon retains a different stage2 surrogate
interpretation: descriptive paired observations only; no scientific conclusions generated
